title: delegatecall to a variable target (solidity) — review required
description: A solidity contract runs delegatecall. The callee code executes in this contract storage and balance context, so a target chosen or upgraded by an attacker can rewrite owner variables and drain funds. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the target is fixed.
remediation: Delegatecall only to a fixed, owner-set implementation address; never to an address derived from input.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: every delegatecall matches, including fixed proxy targets.
